1043.description: Lying on your back, you lift your head against a light load. It strengthens the muscles at the front of the neck.
instructions: Lie on your back on a bench with your head past the edge and a light weight on your forehead.
Hold the weight with a hand for control.
Slowly curl your head up, tucking your chin.
Pause briefly, then lower with control.
Keep the load light and avoid jerking.

1107.description: Leaning back on the straps, you pull your arms up into a Y shape to train the shoulders and upper back.
instructions: Hold the handles and lean back with arms straight and body in a line.
Keep your core tight and feet planted.
Raise your arms up and out until they form a Y overhead.
Pause at the top without shrugging.
Lower slowly back to the start.
Step your feet forward to make it harder.

1171.description: A back extension on a 45 degree bench with a rotation at the top that adds work for the obliques and lower back.
instructions: Position yourself on the bench with your ankles under the pads and your hips just off the edge.
Cross your arms over your chest and lower your torso with a flat back.
Raise your torso back up, squeezing your glutes.
At the top, rotate your upper body gently to one side, then return to center.
Alternate sides each rep and keep the movement slow and controlled.

1235.description: A single-arm row on a seated machine. It lets you load one side of the back at a time.
instructions: Sit at the machine with your chest on the pad and grab one handle.
Start with your arm extended.
Pull the handle toward your torso, driving your elbow back.
Squeeze your shoulder blade, then return slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

1299.description: A machine press with the handles set on an incline path. It works the upper chest and front shoulders with a fixed, stable motion.
instructions: Adjust the seat and backrest of the leverage machine to a comfortable position.
Sit on the machine with your back against the backrest and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles with an overhand grip and position your hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Push the handles forward and away from your body until your arms are fully extended.
Pause for a moment, then slowly bend your elbows and lower the handles back towards your chest.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将杠杆机的座椅和靠背调整到舒适的位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在靠背上，双脚平放在地板上。
正手握住手柄，双手之间的距离略大于肩宽。
向前推动手柄并使其远离身体，直到双臂完全伸展。
暂停片刻，然后慢慢弯曲肘部，将手柄放回到胸部。
重复所需的重复次数。

1363.description: Sit with your legs out in front of you and lean back on your hands. It gives the spine and front of the torso a gentle stretch.
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended in front of you.
Place your hands on the ground behind you, fingers pointing towards your body.
Engage your core and slowly lean back, keeping your back straight.
Continue leaning back until you feel a stretch in your spine.
Hold the stretch for a few seconds, then slowly return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在地上，双腿在身前伸展。
将双手放在身后的地面上，手指指向身体。
启动你的核心并慢慢向后倾斜，保持背部挺直。
继续向后倾斜，直到感觉到脊柱被拉伸。
保持伸展几秒钟，然后慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1427.description: Lie on your side with your legs straight and lift the top leg. It works the outer hip and glute muscles that stabilise your pelvis.
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked on top of each other.
Place your bottom arm under your head for support.
Engage your core and lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips or leaning backward.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 侧躺，双腿伸直并叠放在一起。
将下臂放在头下方以获得支撑。
启动你的核心并尽可能高地抬起你的上腿，不要旋转你的臀部或向后倾斜。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

1491.description: A relaxing lying twist that mobilises the spine and stretches the hips and sides of the trunk.
instructions: Lie on your back with your arms out to the sides.
Pull one knee toward your chest.
Guide that knee across your body toward the floor on the opposite side.
Keep both shoulders on the floor and turn your head the other way if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

1555.description: A simple squat holding a dumbbell in each hand. It is a solid all-round leg builder that is easy to load.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Push your hips back and bend your knees to lower down.
Go until your thighs are parallel to the floor or a bit lower.
Keep your chest up and your heels planted.
Press through your feet to stand back up.

1619.description: A one-arm neutral-grip press on an incline bench. It trains the triceps and upper chest on one side at a time.
instructions: Sit on an incline bench with a dumbbell in one hand, resting on your thigh.
Lean back on the bench and use your thigh to help raise the dumbbell to shoulder height.
Rotate your wrist so that your palm is facing inward, towards your body.
Press the dumbbell up and away from your body, extending your arm fully.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在上斜凳上，一只手拿着哑铃，放在大腿上。
向后靠在长凳上，用大腿帮助将哑铃举至肩膀高度。
旋转手腕，使手掌朝内，朝向身体。
将哑铃向上推离身体，完全伸展手臂。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

1683.description: A biceps curl in the smith machine. The fixed bar path makes it easy to focus on the biceps.
instructions: Adjust the height of the smith machine bar to be at waist level.
Stand facing the smith machine with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the bar with an underhand grip, hands slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keep your elbows close to your sides and your upper arms stationary.
Exhale and curl the bar up towards your shoulders, contracting your biceps.
Pause for a moment at the top of the movement, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the bar back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将史密斯机杆的高度调整到腰部水平。
面对史密斯机站立，双脚与肩同宽。
反手握住杠铃，双手间距略大于肩宽。
保持肘部靠近身体两侧，上臂保持静止。
呼气并将杠铃向上卷向肩膀，收缩二头肌。
在动作的最高点暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气并慢慢将杠铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1747.description: A french press with an EZ bar while seated on an exercise ball. Builds triceps strength and asks your core to keep you stable.
instructions: Sit on an exercise ball and hold an EZ barbell with an overhand grip.
Extend your arms straight up, keeping your elbows close to your head.
Slowly lower the barbell behind your head by bending your elbows.
Pause for a moment, then extend your arms back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在健身球上，正手握住 EZ 杠铃。
向上伸展双臂，保持肘部靠近头部。
弯曲肘部，慢慢将杠铃降低到脑后。
暂停片刻，然后将手臂伸回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

1811.description: Standing on one leg and hugging the other knee to your chest stretches your glutes and tests your balance. A good warm-up move.
instructions: Stand tall, using a wall for balance if needed.
Lift one knee and pull it gently toward your chest with both hands.
Keep your shoulders relaxed and your breathing slow and steady.
Hold for 20-30 seconds without bouncing.
Release gently and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one-sided.

1875.description: Plate-loaded squat machine that lets you load the legs with a supported back.
instructions: Step under the shoulder pads and set your feet shoulder width.
Release the safeties and stand tall.
Sit down and back until your thighs are parallel.
Drive through your heels to stand.
Keep your chest up and your knees tracking over your toes.

1939.description: A lying stretch for the deep hip rotators and glutes, pulling the knee toward the chest.
instructions: Lie on your back and bend both knees.
Bring one knee toward your chest and turn it slightly outward.
Hold the shin and ankle and draw the leg closer.
Keep your lower back resting on the floor.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2259.description: Walking on a treadmill lets you control speed and incline for steady, low-impact cardio.
instructions: Step onto the belt and hold the rails while you start at a slow speed.
Increase to a comfortable walking pace.
Let go of the rails and swing your arms naturally.
Keep your head up and your steps even.
Add some incline if you want more challenge.
Walk for 20-45 minutes and slow down before stepping off.

2323.description: A wide stance squat holding dumbbells that emphasises the glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Stand with your feet wider than your shoulders and toes pointing out.
Hold one or two dumbbells with both hands in front of you.
Sit your hips down and back, keeping your chest up.
Lower until your thighs are about parallel to the floor.
Push through your heels and squeeze your glutes to stand.
Keep your knees in line with your toes.

2515.description: A cable raise to the front that works the front of the shoulders.
instructions: Stand facing away from a low pulley, holding the handle in front of your thighs.
Keep a slight bend in your elbow.
Raise your arm forward to shoulder height.
Avoid leaning back.
Lower slowly.
Finish your reps, then switch arms.

2707.description: Lifting a heavy log from the ground to overhead, building full-body strength and power.
instructions: Stand over the log with feet shoulder width apart and grip it with a firm hold.
Lift it to your lap with a flat back and drive the hips forward.
Rack it on your chest with elbows high.
Dip your knees, then drive up and press the log overhead.
Lock out, then lower with control.
Start light and keep your core braced.

2771.description: Rotating the thigh outward at the hip, working the deep hip rotators and glutes.
instructions: Stand or sit tall with a relaxed posture and the joint in a neutral starting position.
Sit tall on a bench or chair, one knee bent at 90 degrees.
Keep your thigh still and swing your lower leg inward, which rotates the hip outward.
Pause briefly, then return to the starting position under control.
Repeat for 10-15 smooth reps, then switch sides if you are working one side at a time.

2835.description: A weighted sit-to-stand with a narrow stance and cable resistance.
instructions: Sit on a chair holding the cable handle at your chest.
Keep your feet close together.
Lean forward slightly.
Push through your heels to stand.
Lower back under control.

2899.description: A bent-knee side plank that builds oblique and hip strength for beginners.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and your elbow under your shoulder.
Stack your hips and knees.
Press into your forearm to lift your hips off the floor.
Hold a straight line from knees to head.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

2963.description: A straight leg raise on a captain's chair, lifting your legs in front of you. Works the abs and hip flexors.
instructions: Sit on the captain's chair with your back against the backrest and your forearms resting on the arm pads.
Keep your upper body stable and your back straight.
Engage your abs and lift your legs up in front of you, keeping them straight.
Continue lifting until your legs are parallel to the ground or as high as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your legs back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在船长椅上，背部靠在靠背上，前臂放在扶手垫上。
保持上半身稳定，背部挺直。
收紧腹肌并将双腿抬起到身前，保持伸直。
继续抬起，直到双腿与地面平行或达到您可以舒适地达到的高度。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将双腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

3091.description: A bouncy skip with high knee lifts. It warms up the legs and raises your heart rate.
instructions: Stand tall and relaxed.
Skip forward, driving one knee up high.
Hop lightly on the other foot.
Swing the opposite arm forward with each knee.
Alternate legs in a smooth rhythm.
Keep your chest up and land softly.

3219.description: A quick jumping drill where the legs cross in front of each other in the air. It raises your heart rate and builds light, springy legs.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Jump off the ground and simultaneously cross your right leg in front of your left leg.
As you land, quickly switch legs, crossing your left leg in front of your right leg.
Continue alternating legs and jumping as quickly as possible.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立。
跳离地面，同时将右腿交叉到左腿前面。
落地时，快速换腿，将左腿交叉在右腿前面。
继续交替双腿并尽可能快地跳跃。
重复所需的重复次数。

3283.description: A loaded twisting crunch with the legs on a bench, building the abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with your calves on a bench and knees bent.
Hold a light weight against your chest with both hands.
Curl up and rotate one shoulder toward the opposite knee.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides each rep.

3347.description: Curl the dumbbells and keep going into an overhead press, training the arms and shoulders in one smooth rep.
instructions: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in each hand, palms forward.
Curl both weights up to shoulder height without swinging.
Rotate your wrists slightly and press the weights overhead.
Lower to your shoulders, then back down to your sides.
Brace your core and keep your ribs down.

3411.description: Circle your hips to loosen the hip joints and warm up the glutes.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hands on your hips.
Push your hips out to one side, then forward, back and around.
Draw a large smooth circle.
Keep your shoulders still.
Do 10 circles, then reverse direction.

3475.description: A lying tuck stretch easing the hips and lower back.
instructions: Lie on your back.
Hug both knees toward your chest.
Rock gently if comfortable.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Relax your shoulders.
Release slowly.

3539.description: A lying rotation stretch for the upper back.
instructions: Lie on your side with knees bent and arms in front.
Lift your top arm and open it toward the other side.
Follow your hand with your eyes.
Hold for 20-30 seconds.
Return to the start.
Switch sides.

3667.description: A side-lying leg exercise that targets the inner thighs. It trains the adductors and hip stability.
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked on top of each other.
Place your bottom arm under your head for support.
Engage your adductors and lift your top leg as high as possible without rotating your hips or leaning backward.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your leg back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch sides.
instructionsZh: 侧躺，双腿伸直并叠放在一起。
将下臂放在头下方以获得支撑。
启动内收肌并尽可能高地抬起上面的腿，但不要旋转臀部或向后倾斜。
在顶部暂停片刻，然后慢慢将腿放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换边。

3731.description: A romanian deadlift in a wide stance, hitting the hamstrings, glutes and inner thighs.
instructions: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs with a wide stance and toes turned out.
Push your hips back, keeping your knees slightly bent.
Lower the bar along your legs until you feel a hamstring stretch.
Keep your back flat.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.

3795.description: A skiing motion with the band: swing both arms down and back while hinging at the hips. It works your lats, hips and core.
instructions: Anchor the band overhead and hold a handle in each hand.
Stand with soft knees and arms extended in front of you.
Pull the handles down and back past your hips as you hinge forward.
Return the arms up and stand tall in one smooth motion.
Keep your back flat and move with control.

3859.description: A hinged row on the cable stack that trains the mid back and lats with steady tension all the way through.
instructions: Attach a handle or bar to a low pulley and grab it.
Step back and hinge at the hips with a flat back and soft knees.
Start with your arms extended toward the pulley.
Pull the handle toward your lower ribs, driving your elbows back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight again.

3923.description: A one-arm fly on the floor with a landmine bar, training the chest and stability.
instructions: Lie on the floor holding the landmine bar end with one hand.
Extend the arm above your chest.
Lower the bar out to the side in an arc.
Stop when your arm touches the floor.
Squeeze your chest to bring the bar back up.
Switch sides.

3987.description: A wrist curl performed chest down on an incline bench. It isolates the forearm flexors.
instructions: Lie chest down on an incline bench with the barbell in hands, palms up.
Let your wrists extend gently.
Curl your wrists upward.
Squeeze at the top.
Lower slowly.

4051.description: Lying on your side, you lift the top leg. It works the outer hip and glutes.
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs stacked and your head supported.
Keep your hips stacked and core braced.
Lift the top leg up with the toes pointing forward.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch sides.

4115.description: An overhead cable extension with a straight bar, stretching and loading the triceps.
instructions: Set a straight bar on a low pulley and face away from it.
Hold the bar overhead with elbows bent.
Keep your elbows pointing forward.
Extend your arms to straighten them fully.
Lower the bar back behind your head slowly.

4179.description: A deep Smith machine squat with a band adding resistance. It builds quads and glutes.
instructions: Attach the band to the Smith machine and set the bar on your back.
Place feet slightly forward of the bar.
Squat as deep as you can with control.
Keep your chest up.
Drive up through your heels.
Stand tall without locking hard.

4243.description: Throwing a medicine ball up and forward from overhead. It builds full-body explosive power through the core and shoulders.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart holding a medicine ball overhead.
Lean back slightly and brace your core.
Throw the ball forward or against a wall as hard as you can.
Follow through with your arms.
Catch or pick up the ball and reset.
Keep your back from over-arching.

4307.description: A seated rotation with your arms held straight out, loosening the spine and working the waist gently.
instructions: Sit tall on the floor with your legs crossed or extended.
Extend both arms straight out to the sides at shoulder height.
Rotate your torso slowly to one side, keeping your spine long.
Hold for a moment, then rotate to the other side.
Repeat for 8-10 slow rotations each way.

4371.description: A one-armed incline press on a plate-loaded lever machine. It trains the upper chest one side at a time.
instructions: Sit on the machine and grip one handle.
Set your back firmly against the pad.
Press the handle forward and up.
Squeeze your chest at the top.
Return slowly, then switch arms.

4435.description: A squat followed by a high knee drive, combining leg strength with a bit of cardio.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Squat down with your chest lifted.
Stand up explosively and drive one knee up toward your chest.
Land softly and drop into the next squat.
Alternate knees on each rep.

4499.description: A deep squat followed by a press overhead. Warms up legs and shoulders together.
instructions: Stand with feet shoulder width apart and hands at your shoulders.
Squat down until your thighs pass parallel.
Drive up through your heels as you stand.
Press both arms overhead as you reach the top.
Lower your hands back to your shoulders.
Repeat in a smooth rhythm.

4563.description: A calf raise done from a held squat position, mixing calf work with leg endurance.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your sides and sink into a half squat.
Keep your chest tall and weight over your feet.
Lift your heels as high as you can.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower your heels slowly without standing up.
Stay in the squat for the full set.

4627.description: A plank where you lift a dumbbell and the opposite leg at once, testing your balance and core control.
instructions: Start in a high plank with a dumbbell in one hand.
Brace your abs and squeeze your glutes.
Lift the dumbbell forward and the opposite leg back at the same time.
Lower both under control.
Alternate sides each rep.

4691.description: A kneeling side kick that works the glutes and outer hips while challenging balance.
instructions: Kneel on all fours with hands under shoulders.
Lift one leg out to the side, bent.
Extend it into a kick out to the side.
Bend it back in and lower.
Finish the reps and switch legs.

4755.description: A one-leg hip thrust with a dumbbell on your hips. It builds glute strength and hip stability.
instructions: Sit with your upper back on a bench and a dumbbell across your hips.
Plant one foot and lift the other leg off the floor.
Drive through the planted heel to raise your hips until level.
Squeeze your glute at the top.
Lower slowly, finish the reps, then switch legs.

4819.description: Lying on your back with heels in the rings, you bridge up and curl your feet in. It hits the hamstrings hard.
instructions: Lie on your back with your heels in the ring straps and legs extended.
Lift your hips into a bridge.
Bend your knees to pull your heels toward your glutes.
Keep your hips high the whole time.
Extend your legs slowly to return.

4883.description: A floor cycling move that keeps the core working while the legs pedal in the air. It builds abdominal endurance.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands by your head or at your sides.
Lift your shoulders and legs slightly off the floor.
Pedal your legs as if riding a bicycle.
Keep your lower back pressed into the floor.
Breathe steadily and keep a smooth rhythm.
Lower your legs and rest when your form slips.

5011.description: Incline bench press with a stop on your chest. It builds upper chest strength without any bounce.
instructions: Lie on an incline bench and grip the bar slightly wider than shoulders.
Unrack the bar and lower it to your upper chest.
Hold the bar still on your chest for a full second.
Press up until your arms are straight.
Keep your shoulder blades pulled back.

5075.description: Pull a barbell from the floor to your shoulders using only arm and hip drive, with no re-bending of the knees. A good clean-technique builder.
instructions: Set up over the bar with hands just outside your knees and your back flat.
Pull the bar off the floor, extending your hips and knees.
Shrug and pull the elbows high, keeping the bar close.
Rotate your elbows under and catch the bar on your shoulders without dropping into a squat.
Lower the bar back down under control.

5203.description: A standing crunch against band tension. It trains the abs without lying on the floor.
instructions: Anchor the band high and stand facing it with your feet hip-width apart.
Hold the handles at your head.
Bend forward by crunching your ribs toward your pelvis.
Squeeze your abs hard.
Return slowly to standing.

5395.description: Self-massage with a foam roller to ease tightness in the shin. Good before training or on rest days to loosen up.
instructions: Rest one shin on the roller, supporting yourself on your hands.
Place the roller under the shin and let your body weight settle onto it.
Roll gently from below the knee to the ankle, then switch legs.
Pause on tender spots and breathe slowly for 20-30 seconds.
Keep your core braced and avoid rolling over joints or bone.
Roll for 30-60 seconds, then switch sides if needed.

5843.description: A machine fly with an incline angle that emphasizes the upper chest. The handles move in a fixed arc.
instructions: Sit in the machine with your back against the pad.
Grip the handles with elbows slightly bent.
Bring the handles together in front of your upper chest.
Squeeze your chest.
Return slowly to a comfortable stretch.

5907.description: A one-leg balance with the torso and back leg parallel to the floor. Builds balance and strength.
instructions: Stand on one leg with your arms overhead.
Hinge forward and lift the back leg behind you.
Bring your torso and back leg level with the floor.
Hold for 5 slow breaths with your hips square.
Lower and switch legs.

5971.description: A cone drill run in an L shape that sharpens sprinting, backpedaling and quick cuts.
instructions: Place three cones in an L shape, about 5 yards apart.
Sprint from the start cone to the second and touch it.
Backpedal to the start.
Sprint to the second again, turn around the cone and weave around the third.
Return to the start along the same line.
Stay low through turns.

6035.description: A cable row with a parallel bar that targets the rear delts and upper back.
instructions: Sit facing a low cable with a parallel bar attachment.
Hold the handles with your elbows flared.
Lean back slightly with a straight spine.
Pull the handles toward your chest.
Squeeze your shoulder blades.
Return slowly.

6291.description: A wide lunge with arms extended to the sides. It strengthens the legs and opens the hips.
instructions: Stand with feet wide, turn your front foot out and back foot slightly in.
Bend your front knee over the ankle.
Extend both arms parallel to the floor.
Gaze over your front hand.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, then switch sides.

6355.description: A seated chest press on an outdoor lever machine that works your chest, front shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Sit with your back flat against the pad and grip the handles at chest height.
Keep your shoulders down and back.
Press the handles forward until your arms are almost straight.
Pause briefly.
Let the handles come back slowly and repeat.

6419.description: A variation of the band reverse crunch that uses a different setup to challenge your lower abs.
instructions: Lie on your back and hold the band firmly with both hands.
Lift your bent knees over your hips.
Curl your pelvis upward, bringing your knees toward your chest.
Hold for a moment at the top.
Lower with control and repeat.

6547.description: A hold hanging from a bar with the body in a slight hollow curve. It builds deep abdominal tension and grip.
instructions: Grab a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and hang with straight arms.
Brace your abs and tuck your pelvis slightly.
Lift your legs forward a little so your body forms a gentle hollow shape.
Keep your shoulders active and avoid swinging.
Hold the position for as long as you can with good form.
Lower down under control.

6739.description: A kneeling cable move that lifts the leg out to the side. It targets the outer hip muscles.
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low pulley and put it on one ankle.
Kneel on all fours with the cuffed leg on the outside.
Keep your back flat and hips square.
Lift the knee out to the side against the cable.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower with control, then switch legs after your reps.

6803.description: A seated in and out leg drill that goes to the side and then to the front. It works the abs and obliques.
instructions: Sit on the floor leaning back, hands behind you for support.
Lift your feet off the floor with knees bent.
Extend your legs out to one side and pull them back in.
Extend them straight in front and pull back in.
Repeat the pattern on the other side.

7251.description: Hanging straight-body raise toward a front lever position that challenges your abs and lats.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with a firm grip.
Pull your shoulders down and tighten your core.
Raise your straight body up toward horizontal, keeping your arms straight.
Hold the top position for a moment.
Lower slowly without swinging.

8083.description: A standing cable kickback with a straight leg, driven back and slightly out to the side. It isolates the glutes.
instructions: Attach an ankle cuff to a low cable pulley and strap it to one ankle.
Face the machine and hold the frame for balance.
Keep your leg straight and kick it back and slightly out to the side.
Squeeze your glute at the top without leaning forward.
Return slowly without letting the weight stack touch down.
Finish your reps, then switch legs.

9043.description: Hanging from a bar, you hold your body horizontal with your knees tucked. It builds lats and core strength.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip.
Pull your shoulder blades down and tuck your knees to your chest.
Lean back and raise your hips until your back is horizontal.
Keep your arms straight.
Hold for 5-15 seconds.
Lower back down with control.

9491.description: Lying on your side, you raise a cable handle out and up to isolate the side delts with constant tension.
instructions: Set a low pulley and lie on your side with the handle in your top hand.
Keep your arm straight or slightly bent.
Raise the handle in an arc up to about shoulder height or a bit higher.
Pause briefly at the top.
Lower slowly, finish your reps, then switch sides.

9875.description: A seated one-arm cable row where you rotate the torso and wrist as you pull. It works the lats and mid back through a longer range.
instructions: Sit on a bench facing a low cable with your feet braced and take the handle in one hand.
Sit tall with your arm extended and your torso turned slightly toward the cable.
Pull the handle back while rotating your torso and wrist toward your hip.
Squeeze your shoulder blade toward your spine at the end.
Return slowly with your arm extended and your torso rotating back.
Keep your chest up, then switch sides after your reps.

9939.description: A drag-style move where you pull a loaded sled toward you with a rope or strap, walking backward. It trains the back, arms and legs together.
instructions: Attach a rope or strap to a loaded sled and grip it with both hands.
Face the sled, hinge slightly and set your feet.
Pull the rope hand over hand while walking backward.
Keep your chest up and your back straight.
Drive through your legs as the sled comes toward you.
Stop when the sled reaches you and reset.

10003.description: Pull your toes toward your shin against a band while seated. It strengthens the muscles at the front of the lower leg.
instructions: Sit on the floor with your legs straight and loop the band around the top of one foot.
Hold the band ends or anchor them so there is light tension.
Pull your toes toward your shin.
Pause, then return slowly.
Complete all reps, then switch feet.

10195.description: A half kneeling barbell lift that sweeps the bar diagonally up, training the core to control rotation.
instructions: Kneel on one knee holding one end of a barbell in a landmine setup near your hip.
Brace your core and stay tall.
Lift the bar diagonally across your body and up toward the opposite shoulder.
Return the bar slowly to the start.
Keep your hips square. Finish the reps, then switch sides.

10387.description: A walking carry with a sandbag held to the chest, taxing the core, arms and grip.
instructions: Lift the sandbag and hug it against your chest.
Stand tall with your core braced.
Walk forward with steady steps.
Keep your arms squeezing the bag tight.
Carry for a set distance or time, then lower the bag with care.

10899.description: A lying leg lift against a band that works the outer hip. Good for glute and hip stability.
instructions: Loop a band around both legs just above the knees and lie on your side.
Stack your hips and bend your knees slightly.
Lift the top knee or leg away from the bottom one against the band.
Pause at the top.
Lower slowly. Finish your reps and switch sides.

11091.description: A hanging core move done from one hand. Lifting your toes to the bar trains the abs and grip.
instructions: Hang from a bar with one hand and keep your shoulder active.
Brace your core and keep your legs together.
Lift your toes up toward the bar.
Lower your legs slowly without swinging.
Finish your reps, then switch hands.

11283.description: A jump where you tuck the knees and cross the feet in the air, great for conditioning and leg power.
instructions: Stand tall with feet shoulder width apart.
Jump up and pull your knees toward your chest.
Cross your feet in the air.
Land softly on the balls of your feet.
Uncross on the next jump, alternating the crossing foot.
Keep a steady quick rhythm.

11795.description: A shoulder mobility drill moving the arm backward to open the front of the shoulder.
instructions: Stand tall with your arms at your sides.
Press one arm backward, keeping the elbow straight.
Move through a comfortable range.
Return slowly and repeat 8-12 times.
Switch arms.

0019.description: A kneeling machine-assisted triceps dip that lowers the load, so you can build pressing strength in the triceps.
instructions: Adjust the machine to your desired weight and height.
Kneel down on the pad facing the machine, with your hands gripping the handles.
Lower your body by bending your elbows, keeping your back straight and close to the machine.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push yourself back up to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将机器调整到您想要的重量和高度。
跪在面向机器的垫子上，双手握住手柄。
弯曲肘部降低身体，保持背部挺直并靠近机器。
在底部暂停片刻，然后将自己推回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0083.description: Kneeling at a bench, you roll the barbell out and back. A tough core exercise for the abs.
instructions: Start by kneeling on the floor with a barbell placed on a bench in front of you.
Grasp the barbell with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Keeping your core engaged and your back straight, slowly roll the barbell forward, extending your arms in front of you.
Continue rolling the barbell forward until your body is fully extended and your arms are overhead.
Pause for a moment at the fully extended position, then slowly roll the barbell back towards your body, returning to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 首先跪在地板上，将杠铃放在你面前的长凳上。
正手握住杠铃，握距略宽于肩宽。
保持核心收紧，背部挺直，慢慢向前滚动杠铃，将手臂伸到身前。
继续向前滚动杠铃，直到身体完全伸展并且手臂举过头顶。
在完全伸展的位置暂停片刻，然后慢慢地将杠铃向身体方向滚动，回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0147.description: A crunch where the knees pedal while the elbow reaches for the opposite knee. It works the abs and the obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with your hands behind your head and your legs lifted.
Bring one knee toward your chest and rotate to touch the opposite elbow to it.
Extend the other leg straight.
Switch sides in a pedalling motion.
Keep your lower back pressed to the floor.
Move at a steady pace without pulling on your neck.

0211.description: Seated on a stability ball, you rotate a cable handle from hip to hip. It trains the abs and obliques and also challenges your balance.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball with your feet flat on the ground and your knees bent at a 90-degree angle.
Hold the cable handle with both hands and extend your arms straight out in front of you.
Lean back slightly while keeping your back straight and your core engaged.
Twist your torso to the right, bringing the cable handle towards your right hip.
Pause for a moment, then twist your torso to the left, bringing the cable handle towards your left hip.
Continue alternating twists for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 坐在稳定球上，双脚平放在地面上，膝盖弯曲成 90 度角。
双手握住电缆手柄，并将双臂伸直至前方。
稍微向后倾斜，同时保持背部挺直并且核心参与。
将躯干向右扭转，将电缆手柄拉向右臀部。
暂停片刻，然后将躯干向左扭转，将电缆手柄拉向左臀部。
继续交替扭转所需的重复次数。

0275.description: A classic floor crunch. It strengthens the abs with a short, controlled curl.
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and your feet flat.
Place your hands lightly by your head or across your chest.
Curl your shoulders off the floor.
Pause and squeeze your abs.
Lower with control.
Keep your chin off your chest and your lower back on the floor.

0339.description: A lying hamstring curl with a dumbbell. You bend the knees to bring the weight toward the glutes.
instructions: Lie flat on your back with your legs extended and a dumbbell resting on your lower abdomen.
Bend your knees and bring the dumbbell towards your glutes, keeping your feet flat on the ground.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 平躺，双腿伸直，将哑铃放在下腹部。
弯曲膝盖，将哑铃拉向臀部，保持双脚平放在地面上。
在最高点暂停片刻，然后慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0403.description: Seated with your elbow against your thigh, you curl a dumbbell with an overhand grip. It targets the forearm and the upper arm flexors.
instructions: Sit on a bench with your feet flat on the ground and hold a dumbbell in one hand, palm facing up.
Rest your elbow on the inside of your thigh, just above the knee.
Keeping your upper arm stationary, exhale and curl the dumbbell towards your shoulder.
Pause for a moment at the top, squeezing your biceps.
Inhale and slowly lower the dumbbell back to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch arms.
instructionsZh: 坐在长凳上，双脚平放在地上，一手握住哑铃，掌心朝上。
将肘部放在大腿内侧、膝盖上方。
保持上臂静止，呼气并将哑铃向肩膀弯曲。
在顶部暂停片刻，挤压你的二头肌。
吸气，慢慢将哑铃放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换臂。

0467.description: A chin-up variation with a crunch at the top. It works the lats and abs together.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your knees slightly bent.
Grasp a pull-up bar with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Hang from the bar with your arms fully extended and your palms facing away from you.
Engage your core and pull your body up towards the bar, bringing your chin above the bar.
Pause for a moment at the top, then slowly lower your body back down to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，膝盖稍微弯曲。
正手握住引体向上杆，握距略宽于肩宽。
悬挂在杠上，双臂完全伸展，手掌背向自己。
收紧核心肌群，将身体拉向杠铃杆，将下巴置于杠铃上方。
在顶部停顿片刻，然后慢慢将身体放回起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0531.description: Lying on the floor, you press a kettlebell straight up with one arm. A simple way to work the chest and shoulder one side at a time.
instructions: Start by lying on your back on the floor with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground.
Hold a kettlebell in one hand, with your palm facing towards your feet.
Extend your arm straight up towards the ceiling, keeping your elbow locked and your wrist straight.
Slowly lower the kettlebell back down to the starting position, maintaining control throughout the movement.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions, then switch to the other arm.
instructionsZh: 首先仰卧在地板上，膝盖弯曲，双脚平放在地面上。
一只手握住壶铃，手掌朝向脚部。
将手臂伸直向上伸向天花板，保持肘部锁定且手腕伸直。
慢慢地将壶铃放回起始位置，在整个运动过程中保持控制。
重复所需的重复次数，然后换到另一只手臂。

0595.description: Seated on a machine with a chest pad, you curl your torso forward against resistance. Works the abs.
instructions: Adjust the seat height and chest pad position according to your comfort.
Sit on the machine with your back against the chest pad and your feet flat on the floor.
Grasp the handles or side bars for stability.
Engage your abs and slowly lean back, allowing the chest pad to move with you.
Pause for a moment at the maximum contraction, feeling the tension in your abs.
Slowly return to the starting position by contracting your abs and pulling yourself back up.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 根据您的舒适度调整座椅高度和胸垫位置。
坐在机器上，背部靠在胸垫上，双脚平放在地板上。
抓住手柄或侧杆以保持稳定性。
收紧腹肌并慢慢向后倾斜，让胸垫随着您一起移动。
在最大收缩时暂停片刻，感受腹肌的紧张感。
收缩腹肌并将自己拉回来，慢慢回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0659.description: A push-up against a wall, a gentle version for beginners. Works the chest, shoulders and triceps.
instructions: Stand facing a wall, about arm's length away.
Place your hands on the wall at shoulder height, slightly wider than shoulder-width apart.
Step back a few feet, keeping your body straight and your feet hip-width apart.
Bend your elbows and lower your chest towards the wall, keeping your body in a straight line.
Push back up to the starting position, straightening your arms.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 面向墙壁站立，距离大约一臂距离。
将双手放在墙上，与肩同高，距离略宽于肩宽。
后退几英尺，保持身体挺直，双脚分开与臀部同宽。
弯曲肘部，将胸部向墙壁降低，保持身体呈一条直线。
推回起始位置，伸直手臂。
重复所需的重复次数。

0723.description: Lying down with legs straight and vertical, you lift your hips sideways. It targets the lower abs and obliques.
instructions: Lie on your back with legs straight up.
Place your arms by your sides.
Lift your hips off the floor.
Tilt your legs slightly to one side.
Lower with control.
Alternate sides.

0851.description: A sissy squat with added weight, leaning back while the knees travel forward. It isolates the quads.
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and your toes pointing slightly outward.
Hold a weight in front of your chest with both hands, or place a barbell across your upper back.
Keeping your chest up and your core engaged, slowly lower your body down by bending at the knees and hips.
Continue lowering until your thighs are parallel to the ground or as low as you can comfortably go.
Pause for a moment at the bottom, then push through your heels to return to the starting position.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 双脚分开与肩同宽站立，脚趾稍微向外。
用双手将重物放在胸前，或将杠铃放在上背部。
保持挺胸，核心收紧，弯曲膝盖和臀部，慢慢降低身体。
继续降低，直到大腿与地面平行或尽可能低。
在底部停顿片刻，然后推动脚后跟回到起始位置。
重复所需的重复次数。

0915.description: A push up with a band across your back for extra resistance. It strengthens the chest and triceps.
instructions: Loop the band across your upper back, holding the ends under your palms.
Set up in a high plank.
Lower your chest toward the floor.
Press back up against the band.
Keep your body in a straight line.

0979.description: A Pallof press with a band anchored to the side, pressing out and holding. It trains the core to resist rotation.
instructions: Attach the band to a sturdy anchor point at waist height.
Stand perpendicular to the anchor point with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Grasp the band handle with both hands and step away from the anchor point to create tension in the band.
Bring your hands to your chest, keeping your elbows bent and close to your body.
Engage your core and maintain a stable stance.
Extend your arms straight out in front of you, pushing the band away from your body.
Hold the extended position for a few seconds, focusing on maintaining tension in your core.
Slowly bring your hands back to your chest, resisting the pull of the band.
Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
instructionsZh: 将带子固定在腰部高度的坚固锚点上。
垂直于锚点站立，双脚分开与肩同宽。
用双手抓住带子手柄并远离锚点以在带子中产生张力。
将双手放在胸前，保持肘部弯曲并靠近身体。
调动你的核心并保持稳定的姿势。
将手臂伸直至前方，将弹力带推离身体。
保持伸展姿势几秒钟，专注于保持核心紧张。
慢慢地将双手放回胸前，抵抗弹力带的拉力。
重复所需的重复次数。
